column1: # Migration TARGETS and how well each is proven. Read by ./setup, the migrate-mod skill and
# tools/supported-versions.py; the rules are in SUPPORTED_VERSIONS.md. Do not compute the status by hand:
#   status = override if set, else "tested" when mods_gate_c >= 10, else "reported".
# A version not listed is UNTESTED. Columns (tab-separated):
#   mods_gate_c  distinct mods ported to this target whose Gate C (real client) passed
#   override     empty, or "tested"/"reported" set by the owner by hand, with the reason in evidence

column5: owner: the default target since before this policy; dozens of ports and two blind replays through Gates A-C
